Docs.summary: Provides access to user interest topics through the Android Topics API.

remarks.para: Use to request topics with a and receive a . A identifies an interest category and includes the versions of its taxonomy and classifier model. contains an encrypted topic and the key information needed to decrypt it.

The Topics API derives interest categories from app activity. A request can record that its caller has observed the host app's topics. This observation is used to determine whether the caller can receive the topic in the next epoch, a period of topic computation.
The Android Topics APIs are deprecated in API level 37 and have no direct replacement. Applications should stop using them because future Android releases will reject calls.
For more information, see the Android Topics API reference and the Topics on Android guide.
